verdict.rationale: Relay's own pages say it offers high-yield savings accounts (up to 3.00% APY) and auto-transfer rules that move excess cash from operating accounts into savings, framed explicitly as building a cash cushion. Transfers can be set by dollar amounts or percentages, and a community user confirms Relay partitions money automatically and pays extra interest on set-aside funds. Missing for 10: in-depth setup docs for savings auto-transfer rules (thresholds, schedules, triggers), and stronger hands-on corroboration of the savings rules specifically.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can build a cash cushion in a high-yield savings sub-account with automated transfer rules

citations.quote: Build a cash cushion with high-yield accounts and automated rules that help you stay ready for whatever’s next.
Relay moves idle cash out of operating accounts and into your savings. Earn up to 3.00% APY1 on every spare dollar.
Relay’s auto-transfer rules make it easy by moving your excess cash out of operating accounts and into savings for you.
Automate transfers from one to multiple accounts using dollar amounts or percentages.
Relay does a good job of automatically partitioning money
